title: Implementer guides consistency pass post-recent-edits
description:
The three implementer guides have not been re-read since the recent normative changes:
- jmap-chat-push-platform-guide.md
- jmap-chat-wss-guide.md
- jmap-push-platform-guide.md

Recent changes that might have invalidated guide content:
- c93e545: removed normative single-owner concept for Spaces
- 9344aec: removed 'manage_emoji' permission and server-admin emoji authorization
- 38055ec: added per-method auth latitude paragraph
- 970bad6: clarified server-side authorization model

Quick check: grep -rn --include='*.md' 'Space owner\|manage_emoji\|server admin authorization' . — anything in a guide file is stale.

Deeper check: read each guide end-to-end looking for descriptions of behavior that contradict or duplicate normative text. Implementer guides should describe deployment practice without restating normative rules; descriptions of who-may-do-what are particularly likely to be stale after the recent governance edits.

The federation draft's findings should also be cross-checked against the guides (e.g., if a guide describes typing-rate-limit behavior with the old 3-second number explicitly, that's consistent with the current draft but should be reviewed if ic5s.2 lands).

File specific findings as separate beads. Close this bead with a summary.
acceptance_criteria:
- All three guides read end-to-end
- Any stale 'Space owner', 'manage_emoji', or 'server admin authorization' references found via grep are filed for correction
- Deeper inconsistencies (paraphrased normative rules, outdated behavior descriptions) are filed
- Close-reason summarizes findings; 'no findings' is acceptable
